p: enemy had said against you: That is, the Idumean.
high places are ours in possession: That is Jerusalem, which for God's promises was the chief of all the world.
talkers: You are made a matter of talk and derision to all the world.
appointed my land into their possession: They appointed with themselves to have it, and therefore came with Nebuchadnezzar against Jerusalem for this purpose.
shame of the nations: Because you have been a laughing stock to them.
lifted up my hand: By making a solemn oath. See Geneva "Eze 20:5"
shoot forth your branches: God declares his mercies and goodness toward his Church, who still preserves his, even when he destroys his enemies.
at your beginnings: Which was accomplished under Christ, to whom all these temporal deliverances directed them.
upon you: That is, on the mountains of Jerusalem.
land devourest men: This the enemies imputed as the reproach of the land, which God did for the sins of the people according to his just judgments.
name: And therefore would not permit my Name to be had in contempt, as the heathen would have reproached me, if I had allowed my Church to perish.
holy name's sake: This excludes from man all dignity and means to deserve anything by, seeing that God refers the whole to himself and that only for the glory of his holy Name.
water upon you: That is, his spirit by which he reforms the heart and regenerates his. See Geneva "Isa 44:3"
grain: Under the abundance of temporal benefits he concludes the spiritual graces.
lothe yourselves in your own sight: You will come to true repentance and think yourselves unworthy to be of the number of God's creatures, for your ingratitude against him.

know that I the LORD build: He declares that it ought not to be referred to the soil or plentifulness of the earth that any country is rich and abundant, but only to God's mercies, as his plagues and curses declare, when he makes it barren.
